name: Sunfield Youth Sports Academy
tagline: Baseball, softball, soccer and volleyball for Baytown kids and teens.

band.title: Fall registration is open
band.text: Call Sunfield Sports at (281) 555-0148, or send a question and a coach will help you pick the right program.

hero.eyebrow: Baseball, softball, soccer and volleyball in Baytown
hero.title: Where Baytown kids learn to love the game
hero.lead: Teams, leagues, clinics and summer camp for ages 4 to 18, coached by people who teach the fundamentals first and keep it fun all season.
hero.imageAlt: A coach talking with a young soccer team in red and white kits on a turf field

programs.title: Select Baseball
programs.summary: Tournament teams from 8U to 14U, with two practices a week and a coach for every twelve players.
text: Select teams are for players who want more than a rec season: a full fall schedule of weekend tournaments across the Houston area, and practices built around hitting, fielding and throwing the right way.
We hold tryouts each July. Every player who tries out gets written feedback from the coaching staff, whether or not they make a roster.
programs.schedule: Mon and Wed, 5:30 – 7:30 PM, plus weekend tournaments
points: Two practices a week on our own fields
Six to eight weekend tournaments
Hitting and pitching sessions in the cages
Written player feedback at mid-season
rules: Players supply their own glove, bat and cleats
programs.imageAlt: A young batter in a blue jersey swinging at a pitch in front of the catcher

programs.title: Softball Skills Clinic
programs.summary: Saturday morning clinics for girls who want sharper fielding, hitting and catching.
programs.text: Each clinic covers one part of the game in depth, with small groups so every player gets plenty of reps. Come to one or come to all of them.
points: Groups of eight or fewer per coach
A different skill each week
Catcher and pitcher stations
programs.imageAlt: A ball held in a worn leather fielding glove

programs.title: Rec Soccer League
programs.summary: A friendly spring league where every player plays at least half of every game.
programs.text: We balance teams by age and skill. Each team practices once a week and plays one game on Saturdays. The focus is on touches on the ball, teamwork and having a good time.
points: Every player plays half of every game
Small-sided games for the youngest players
Parent coaches trained by our staff
programs.imageAlt: Young soccer players in orange jerseys chasing the ball on a grass field

programs.title: Volleyball Academy
programs.summary: Year-round training for middle and high school players, from first serves to club tryouts.
programs.text: We group players by skill as well as age, and they move up as they improve. Sessions mix drills, conditioning and scrimmage play in our indoor gym.
points: Skill groups from beginner to club level
Video review of serves and approaches
Indoor courts with a climate-controlled gym
programs.imageAlt: High school volleyball players celebrating a point on an indoor court

programs.title: Summer Sports Camp
programs.summary: Weekly day camp with a different sport every day, plus water games on Fridays.
programs.text: Campers rotate through baseball, soccer, volleyball and field games, with breaks in the shade and a long lunch. Sign up for one week or the whole summer.
points: A new sport every day
Counselors trained in first aid
Water games every Friday
rules: Campers bring a lunch and a refillable water bottle
programs.imageAlt: A boy kicking a blue soccer ball across a grass field while other kids watch

programs.title: Private Lessons
programs.summary: One-on-one hitting, pitching and fielding lessons with a Sunfield coach.
programs.imageAlt: A young hitter in a batting helmet holding a bat

programsIntro: Teams, leagues, clinics, lessons and camp, from first-time players to tournament rosters. Not sure where your child fits? Call and a coach will help.

schedule.title: The fall season at a glance
schedule.text: Fall registration is open for Select Baseball and the Volleyball Academy. Spots on each team are limited.

Forty-five minutes in the party room

packages.name: Team Event

about.title: Fundamentals first, and fun the whole way
text: Sunfield started in 2012 with one baseball field, a borrowed batting cage and twenty players. Today it is a six-acre complex on Bayway Drive with two lighted fields, an indoor gym and cages that stay busy every evening.
The idea has not changed. Kids learn the fundamentals from coaches who know how to teach them, play a lot, and leave every practice wanting to come back.
about.imageAlt: A youth baseball game seen from behind home plate under a blue sky
points: Two lighted fields
Indoor gym with two volleyball courts
Four batting cages
Covered seating for parents

staff.name: Kendra Ellis

faqs.q: My child has never played before. Is there a program for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes. The Rec Soccer League, the Softball Skills Clinic and Summer Sports Camp all welcome first-time players, and coaches group kids by skill as well as age.

faqs.q: What should my child bring to the first practice?
faqs.a: Athletic shoes or cleats, a water bottle and any gear listed for the program. We have loaner gloves and helmets for anyone who needs one.
Yes. The second child in a family gets $20 off any league or camp week, and each child after that gets $30 off.
We move outdoor practices to the indoor gym when we can. When we cannot, we text every family by 3 PM.

reviews.author: Rec soccer parent
reviews.text: My daughter was nervous to play her first season and her coach made her feel like part of the team from day one. She is already asking about spring.

reviews.author: Select baseball family
reviews.text: The coaching is the real thing. My son's swing changed completely in one fall, and the written feedback at mid-season was a nice surprise.

reviews.author: Summer camp parent
reviews.text: Two kids, four weeks of camp, and they came home tired and happy every single day. Friday water games were the highlight.

facts.heading: Safety
items: Every coach passes a background check
Coaches hold current CPR and first aid certification
An athletic trainer on site for select tournaments

facts.heading: Payment
facts.text: Card, cash or check. League and season fees can be split into three monthly payments.

facts.heading: Scholarships
facts.text: Need-based scholarships cover part or all of a season. Ask at the front desk for an application.
